Class CurrentUserProvider

Namespace
HiveSync.Application
Assembly
HiveSync.Application.dll

Provides access to information about the currently authenticated user based on claims stored in the HTTP context.

This implementation relies on JWT claims and assumes that:

  • NameIdentifier contains the user ID (GUID)
  • A custom claim "inbox_id" contains the default Inbox project ID (GUID)
  • Email contains the user's email

Throws UnauthorizedAccessException if required claims are missing or the user is not authenticated.
